description: Reference machine: 16 GB worker GPU (RTX 5070 Ti) + 6 GB second GPU (RTX 2060), 64 GB RAM. Everything we tested.

routing._source: capability suites (evals/scorecard-gemma-qwen.md: Gemma 4 vs Qwen3.6 on the same tooling) and the first suite (evals/scorecard-suite.md), Godot suite (evals/scorecard-godot.md) on the reference machine: RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB + RTX 2060 6 GB, 64 GB RAM

worker.why: capability suite rerun, 2 runs per task: 19/20 agent runs passed (mean 0.995; Qwen3.6 on the same tooling 16/20) across coding, UE Python/C++/render, Blender, ffmpeg, audio; 57 min total vs 80, 172 turns vs 401, peak context 45K of 131K; also the Godot worker (8/8), so one model for all agent work and no reloads

retry.why: a different model family from the worker (a retry shouldn't repeat the first attempt's blind spot); 19/20 in the first suite, 8/8 Godot, best-looking renders by eye; ~3x slower

long_context.why: 3/3 recall at 24K/106K/188K, prefill ~900 tok/s; use for reading huge logs or files beyond ~100K tokens

log_triage_fast.why: 0.56-0.75 triage score (varies run to run) in ~20 s on the small second GPU; first pass only, Claude confirms. Gemma 4 E4B scores 0.69 but takes ~90 s

vision_prescreen.why: synthetic frames: exposure 20/20 twice, defects 8/8 twice (Qwen3.6: 0.93 / 1.00). Pre-screen only: Claude makes the call

frame_qa.why: decision model: 96 real frames (UE trailer, NeonRain, Godot game and suite shots, 6 controlled variants each): 95% at 0.42 s/frame (defects 96%, black 99%, exposure 89%); Gemma 4 26B 92% at 7.3 s. Right on every frame where it was >= 0.8 confident about a defect. Use it to screen every rendered frame and flag the rest for a look; exposure is unreliable on dark-by-design and UI frames. Not for logs (79% of causes; Spark 87%). evals/scorecard-decide.md

harness.why: Claude Code worker: 19/20 per model; OpenCode with the same Bonsai: 7/10, slower, more context

gpu_policy.why: agent context needs 20-112K (too much for the 32K co-resident mode); one worker model for everything avoids reloads; a reload takes ~4-5 s (warm page cache) plus re-reading the worker's context

claude_only: brief, plan, shot design, final creative calls
visual QA verdicts (local vision is pre-screen only)
musical tempo/structure review (graders can't check tempo reliably)

worker.why: Godot suite, 2 runs per task: 8/8 passed, ~31 min per 4 tasks (fastest, fewest turns/context): port 3->4, race logic 21/21, platformer + exports, Movie Maker clip

retry.why: also 8/8 (~91 min per 4 tasks, ~3x slower) and the best-looking clips by eye: retries and look-critical steps

not_recommended.qwen3.6-35b-a3b: 4/8 over 2 runs (rep 2: 3/4 after the tooling fixes): fails the platformer (autopilot timing + time limit)
not_recommended.mellum2.1-12b: 0/4 on an older llama.cpp; on the current one a coding bug fix passes but Godot race logic fails (0/21 tests). Fast, but every role it could take is already covered as well or better (evals/scorecard-decide.md)
not_recommended.qwen3.8-27b-q3: 1/4: limited by the 49K context that fits in 16 GB (template fixed)

log_triage.why: UE log triage 0.88 (first suite); Qwen3.6 0.75, Gemma 4 0.50 (rerun). Claude confirms

fallback_worker.why: 16/20 on the suite rerun (missed a key signature, a light, wrote a C++ test with 0 asserts); fastest tokens (77 tok/s) but 2.3x the turns
